title: Bridge same-key ite/abs atoms before generalizing theory rewrites
summary: Theory rewrite steps over ite, abs, div, mod, and application atoms are now proved by bridging same-key atoms with equalities, generalizing them, and deciding the linear rest, with the unfolded proof as fallback. Sums of a dozen absolute values, which previously timed out in Lean, now certify in about a second through both proof cores.
